semiconductor_relevance: Low — Xiamen Xlong Seal Co., Ltd. primarily provides sealing products and services across various industries, including semiconductors, but does not specialize in semiconductor manufacturing or design.
summary: Xiamen Xlong Seal Co., Ltd. manufactures sealing components and provides related services to a wide range of industries, including semiconductors. They offer high-quality sealing solutions, leveraging proprietary designs and materials, and support customers globally with technical assistance.

regional_presence.China: The company operates two national high-tech manufacturing plants in Ningbo and Xiamen, along with six marketing teams across major cities.
